Name: Cute Valley - Pink
Author: Rosiea
Description:
highly recommended to use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]generic mod config menu[/url] so you can turn off things you don't want enabled or want to mix and match with another mod :)

hi! i'm Rosalie from stardew forums, bringing Cute Valley over to nexus!

i've recolored and retextured a lot of craftables and other assets, along with combining other creator's furniture with this mod! (with permission)

please see my [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]original thread[/url] for full proper crediting ♥ 
[i]additional credits: JinxieWinxie has not been online in quite some time, and has not been able to update her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/191]scarekitties[/url]. since i have the mod combined with mine, i've used one of her kitties as a base to make deluxe scarecrow
and of course credit to ConcernedApe![/i]

[b]do NOT upload anywhere else![/b]
